name: Greet Bubble — Video Welcome Popup & Floating Video Bubble with Contact Form Integration
author: ThemeAtelier

sections.description:
Greet Bubble is a video welcome popup and floating video bubble plugin that helps you greet visitors with personalized video messages. Add an engaging video popup to your website to create a strong first impression and instantly capture attention with a welcome popup. Show different video welcome popup messages for each page, post, or custom post type like products and events, so you can deliver the right message to the right audience. Perfect for creating engaging video welcome popups for landing pages, product pages, and event promotions.

With Greet Bubble, you can display video welcome popup content on specific pages, add call-to-action buttons, connect contact forms, and guide visitors to important links. Whether you’re promoting offers, introducing your brand, or welcoming new users, this plugin helps you communicate more effectively.

Easily customize your floating video bubble with different styles, positions, colors, and animations to match your website design. Lightweight and fully responsive, Greet Bubble ensures smooth performance across all devices while helping you boost engagement and conversions. Works perfectly with WooCommerce products, events, pages, and custom post types.

Video Welcome Popup & Floating Video Bubble for Your Website

Greet Bubble helps you create engaging video welcome popups and floating video bubbles to greet visitors, promote offers, and guide users with interactive video messaging more effectively. Perfect for landing pages, WooCommerce products, and event promotions.

Key Features of Greet Video Bubble Plugin

Greet Bubble combines video popup, floating video bubble, and interactive video messaging in one lightweight plugin.

  • Video Welcome Popup Display: Showcase engaging introductory videos about your product or service, with interactive buttons for external actions.
  • Multiple Video Popup Controls: Assign different videos to buttons, allowing users to switch between them easily.
  • Drag-and-Drop Management: Effortlessly organize video items using a simple drag-and-drop interface.
  • Customizable Video Poster: Set default video thumbnails or posters to enhance video presentation.
  • Editable Button Text and Icons: Personalize button text and icons to match your content.
  • Flexible Button Behavior: Configure buttons to play videos or link to external pages and URLs.
  • Internal and External Linking: Easily link buttons to internal site pages or external websites.
  • Bubble Intro Text Customization: Customize the introductory text displayed within the video bubble.
  • Bubble Positioning Options: Position the video bubble on the left or right side of the screen.
  • Precise Positioning Controls: Control bubble placement using pixel (px), em, or percentage (%) values for precise bottom-corner positioning.
  • Video Pausing on Tab Switch: Automatically pause videos when users switch browser tabs.
  • Customizable Colors: Customize all colors, including bubble and button colors, to match your brand palette.
  • Advanced Appearance Settings: Fine-tune the plugin’s appearance with extensive customization options.
  • Multiple Button Display Styles: Choose between text-only buttons or buttons with both icons and text.
  • Adjustable Button Shapes: Select square or rounded button styles.
  • Border Radius Control: Customize the border radius for rounded buttons.
  • Custom Button Colors: Adjust button backgrounds, text colors, hover effects, and hover colors.
  • Custom CSS and JavaScript: Add custom CSS and JavaScript directly from the plugin settings panel.
  • Easy Settings Panel: Manage all settings from a clean, user-friendly control panel.
  • Responsive Design: Ensures the plugin looks great on all devices, including desktop and mobile.
  • Multisite Support: Fully compatible with WordPress multisite installations.
  • Multilingual Ready: Easily translate the plugin into multiple languages.
  • RTL Language Support: Fully compatible with right-to-left (RTL) languages.
  • Theme Compatibility: Works seamlessly with all WordPress themes.
  • Developer-Friendly: Designed to be easily extended and customized by developers.
  • SEO Optimized: Built with clean, optimized code to help maintain SEO performance.
  • Cross-Browser Compatibility: Works across all major browsers, including Firefox, Chrome, Safari, Edge, and Opera.
  • Comprehensive Documentation & Tutorials: Includes detailed documentation and video tutorials for easy setup.
  • Fast and Responsive Support: Get quick and helpful assistance whenever you need it.

Use Cases

  • Add a video welcome popup to greet new visitors
  • Display product-specific video bubbles on WooCommerce pages
  • Show event-specific welcome videos for event pages
  • Guide users with interactive video messages and high-converting call-to-action buttons
  • Capture leads using contact forms inside video bubbles

sections.installation:
AUTOMATIC INSTALLATION (EASIEST WAY)

  • Visit Plugins > Add New
  • Search for Greet Bubble
  • Install and activate the Greet Bubble plugin

MANUAL INSTALLATION

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  • Download greet-bubble.zip
  • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  • Click on the “Upload Plugin” button
  • Choose the greet-bubble.zip file from your computer
  • Click “Install Now”
  • Activate the plugin after installation

Using FTP

  • Download greet-bubble.zip
  • Extract the greet-bubble folder on your computer
  • Upload the greet-bubble folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress

After Activation

  • Go to the “Greet Bubble” menu from the left sidebar in your WordPress dashboard
  • Configure your video welcome popup and floating video bubble settings as needed
sections.faq:
How do I add a video welcome popup to my website?

You can easily create a video welcome popup using Greet Bubble by adding your video, customizing the floating video bubble, and choosing where it appears on your pages or posts.

Can I show different video popups on different pages?

Yes, Greet Bubble allows you to display different video welcome popups for each page, post, or custom post type such as WooCommerce products and event pages.

Can I add a contact form inside the video popup?

Yes, you can connect contact forms inside the video bubble to capture leads and allow visitors to contact you directly from the popup.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce products?

Yes, Greet Bubble works perfectly with WooCommerce and lets you show product-specific video popups to improve conversions on product pages.

Can I add buttons or links inside the video bubble?

Yes, you can add call-to-action buttons that play videos or link to internal pages and external URLs.

Is the video popup mobile-friendly?

Yes, the video welcome popup and floating video bubble are fully responsive and work smoothly on all devices, including mobile and tablets.

Can I customize the appearance of the video bubble?

Yes, you can customize colors, position, animations, button styles, and more to match your website design.

Will the video popup slow down my website?

No, Greet Bubble is lightweight and optimized for performance to ensure fast loading and smooth user experience.

Can I use multiple videos in one bubble?

Yes, you can add multiple videos and allow users to switch between them using interactive buttons.

Is this plugin suitable for lead generation?

Yes, Greet Bubble helps you capture leads using contact forms, call-to-action buttons, and engaging video messages.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No, Greet Bubble is beginner-friendly and comes with an easy-to-use settings panel for quick setup.

Can I use this plugin for landing pages and marketing campaigns?

Yes, Greet Bubble is perfect for landing pages, marketing campaigns, product promotions, and event pages.
